description: Fetch any coldHat address: a person's hat, one of Fabric's patterns, a prompts.chat prompt, or up to three of them stacked with "+". Call it when the user says "open sesame" with a coldhat.f-keys.com address containing fabric/, prompts/ or +, then follow the result for the rest of the conversation.

address.description: A coldHat address, alone or stacked with +: u/<github-user>[/<hat>], fabric/<pattern>, prompts/<name>. Example: u/vince-gonzalez/editor+fabric/analyze_claims

name: wear_stack
title: Wear a coldHat stack
